caption: The drawing depicts a rounded, metallic object in a brownish-bronze color, resembling a piggy bank, with a sturdy, flared base. On top of the spherical portion, there is a sculpted cat lying down with its head resting on its front paws. The cat's features and limbs are clearly defined and rendered in the same metallic color as the rest of the bank. On the front surface of the sphere, there is raised text that reads "TABBY BANK" with a decorative flourish or emblem between the two words. There is a coin slot visible at the top right behind the cat's body, and on the left side of the sphere there is a protruding snout-like form. The background is plain and off-white, with the artist's signature, "Geo. J. File," written at the lower right corner.
title: Toy Bank: Tabby Cat
